reviews.x: Very cute and stylish. Kids loved them and we put them in the gift bags.
I would give these 10 stars if I could!  These hair ties are exactly as pictured and the kids went crazy for them!  I love the cute packaging too!  Will definitely be a repeat customer!
These were such a hit! The kids loved them!

reviews.t: LOVE that they say " Thank you for making my ...
reviews.x: I am giving these out as party of my daughter's birthday party favors. They will be both worn as bracelets (with the golden sparkle) and hair ties I am sure. LOVE that they say " Thank you for making my birthday magical". Graphics are clear and colorful. So impressed with how well made these hair ties are made. Super cute packaging. Would be great if they came in a multi-color pack with purple, red, and orange.

These hair ties are the sweetest parting gift ever.  They actually say thank you on them, so you don't even have to add anything else if you don't want to. Of course, they would be the perfect addition to a full goodie bag.  They are even cuter in person than in the photo.
Included in party goodie bags. The kids loved them. The hair ties made for great braclets too!

Super adorable hair ties! I purchased to put these in my daughters party favors for her unicorn themed party. We love them! Product is very high quality. Came in super cute packaging. Amazing customer service! I received an email thanking me for my purchase along with an email when I received my order. I wish I had seen the unicorn tattoos when I placed this order! Will definitely order from this company again!

I ordered these as filler is in little grab bags that I created for the little sisters that had to attend all their brothers baseball games.  The presentation of these were so cute two bracelets on a little card the quality was amazing, and the girls love them raging from ages 2 to 8 so it was a big success  The purchase was well worth it. The vendor is a great vendor. I would suggest trying them out

Simple and so cute and useful for a 6 yr old party bag.  Disclosure - personally i dont like all the little toys and misc stuff in gift bags - it just ends up rolling around in my car after a bday party SOOOO thats all i gave -  a set of hair bands, balloons from the party tables (lol)  for each little girl and loaded them up on pizza, cake and cupcakes- you are welcome parents!

I absolutely love these! I love that they are pretty to wear as a bracelet, and useful for when you need a hair tie! The kids loved them at the birthday party we had, and I kept 2 for myself. The card they came on is adorable. I like how it says, "Thank you for making my birthday party magical." They were perfect for our unicorn themed birthday party. Very well made!

I bought these for my daughter's unicorn themed party and it was a great idea because all the little girls loved them! Plus it doubled as a built in thank you card so major time saver for me! They're also practical and reusable. All the girls started using them right away. It was cute! Would definitely buy from this seller again!

reviews.t: These hair ties were so incredibly cute and perfect for my daughter's unicorn-themed birthday party
reviews.x: These hair ties were so incredibly cute and perfect for my daughter's unicorn-themed birthday party.  The price can't be beat and the quality is great!  I also loved the cute card it came with - perfect to slip into the favor bags.  My daughter uses her ties every day and gets so many compliments on the cute unicorn design.

reviews.t: Perfect gift item for a party
reviews.x: These hair ties are SO adorable and are perfect for my daughter’s upcoming unicorn themed party. They are packaged just right as a gift item for guests to take home with them. They arrived in a timely manner. There is enough variety that I know the girls at the party will have an inner debate as to which one they will want.

Beautifully packaged and super cute.  They are going to make excellent thank you gift for my daughters unicorn birthday party!  Only thing better would be making the package available in different quantities.  I would have loved a ten pack!  My daughter is forgoing keeping herself one so her friends all get one.

These are the most beautiful hair clips I’ve ever seen and they are bracelets too! The box and the packing is so well done! You can see they put their heart on it!!! The message in the cards also are very beautiful!! I am very happy with these product!!! My daughter and her friends love it!!!

reviews.t: Really nice packaging and reasonably priced
reviews.x: I bought these as one of the party favors for my daughter’s 8th birthday party. She loved them and so did all the girls. They can be worn as hair ties or bracelets. They are very cute and the packaging is very nice too! The price was also very reasonable. I’m very happy with this purchase!

Bought these for the goodie bags we will put together for my granddaughters unicorn birthday party.  They are very cute and the inscription is a thank you!  Party hasn't happened yet, but feel confident that the recipients of these will be happy!

These are just lovely.  I purchased several sets to include in favor bags for my daughter's unicorn birthday party.  They were exactly what I was looking for. The card and hair ties were of good quality. And there is a thank you note on the card.

These were used as a portion of my daughter's gusts party favor bags. Each girl immediately ooohhed and aahhhed over them! They have perfect presentation and are ready to go when you receive them! Absolutely worth every penny...and then some!

These are absolutely adorable, even I want one for myself. The packaging is precious and well made. I’m using these as gift take always for my daughters birthday but they’re honestly so cute even for adults. I’m very happy with my purchase.

These Unicorn tie backs are precious. I add to my granddaughters favor for her Unicorn party. Some of them had only one attached instead of 2. I let the seller know and she replaced. Thank you so much. The bags I made came out adorable

I bought these as party favors for my daughters birthday. Super cute! The packaging is great - the two hair ties are around a thin cardboard piece. I like that there's two different main colors. These are totally reasonably priced.

The hairties were cute, but I bought them with the intention of them matching the other Hugo and Emmy party bags and tattoos, and the cute card depicted online was not what I received (see image provided).
These were great to give in party favor bags at kids birthday party. The girls loved them, they were all wearing them as they left and at school the next week. Very cute packaging to give as gifts.

reviews.t: Cute on the wrist and in your hair
reviews.x: These hair ties were adorable. Very cute packaging and made great gifts for my daughter‘s birthday party. They are so cute I started wearing them too because they look great on my wrist as well.

claims.text: Customers frequently describe the hair ties as cute and adorable, and say kids loved them.
Many reviewers praise the cute packaging and the included thank-you card, which doubles as a party favor message.
Reviewers commonly note the ties work well as bracelets too, making them pretty and practical.
Several customers highlight the high quality and good value of the product.
A few reviewers mention wanting the option to buy different quantities, such as a ten pack.
